title: Room guidance: warm bath (card 7). Pool, 21 Nov 2026
weak: Edmonton uses NBC 2023 (AE) Part 7; Vancouver uses the BC Pool Regulation and BC Guidelines 2025, with some Part 7 items as tool extensions.
Several room sizes (thermal rooms, rest area, spare-floor options) are the definition's design values or trade figures (trust 30-50), not code.
The bather load rule here (1.0 m² of water a person) is the definition's; it conflicts with the NBC(AE) / BC Guidelines rate in an open conflict in the rule book. Both shown.
